scoring_justification: The full phonon-dispersion/scattering model is analytically approximated by the paper's own fitting formula (Eq. 15) with ≤1% accuracy. We recompute the three κ values from that closed-form formula using the same public parameters, avoiding heavy reimplementation while still verifying the algorithmic result.

outputs.description: Lattice thermal conductivity for ideal and doped graphene. The checker will independently recompute the same phonon model and compare the agent's κ values within 10% relative tolerance, and verify the ordering ideal > doped_Al > doped_N.

output_contract.notes: The scored CSV must contain exactly three rows with conditions 'ideal', 'doped_Al', 'doped_N' and corresponding κ in W/(m·K). No gold values are disclosed here.
